title: DevLinks
tagline: Developer-focused bio-link platform built with MERN — one shareable profile for GitHub, LinkedIn, portfolio, and skills.
problem: Developers scatter their presence across GitHub, LinkedIn, portfolios, and side projects, forcing recruiters to piece context together manually. Generic link-in-bio tools lack developer-centric structure, role-based demos, and production patterns such as secure auth, moderation, and link analytics.
approach: **HttpOnly JWT sessions:** Auth tokens are issued in `HttpOnly` cookies with production `SameSite=None` and `Secure` flags so the SPA on Vercel can talk to the API on Render without exposing tokens to JavaScript.

**RBAC with safe demos:** User and admin roles power separate surfaces — a profile/links dashboard for developers and a moderation panel for admins — including guest logins and demo-admin delete limits so public demos cannot wipe real accounts.

**Modular product API:** Express routes for auth, users, links, public profiles, and admin stats, with Zod validation, soft delete, Cloudinary avatars, click/view counters, and a shareable `/u/:username` page.
challenges: **Cross-origin auth & CORS:** Fixed credentialed requests between Vercel and Render by aligning `CLIENT_URL` (no trailing slash), enabling CORS credentials, and tuning cookie policy for cross-site sessions.
**Soft-delete vs unique indexes:** Guest re-login after soft delete collided on unique username/email; resolved by restoring soft-deleted guest documents instead of inserting duplicates.
**SPA deep links in production:** Direct visits to `/u/:username` 404’d on Vercel until client-side routes were rewritten to `index.html`.
result: Deployed end-to-end with guest user/admin demos, live dashboard preview, drag-and-drop link ordering, QR share, and an admin control panel. Delivers a recruiter-ready public profile flow backed by production-minded auth, validation, and moderation rules.
